page.content:
End-Cretaceous mass extinction that killed non-avian dinosaurs.

How K–Pg extinction connects

  • Topic: Dinosauria — The K–Pg extinction ended non-avian members of Dinosauria.
  • Location: Chicxulub crater — The Chicxulub impact is the leading cause of the K–Pg extinction.
  • Location: Hell Creek Formation — Hell Creek records the K–Pg boundary that ends its dinosaurs.
  • Topic: Birds — Avian dinosaurs survived the K–Pg event that killed the rest.

What is K–Pg extinction?

The Cretaceous–Paleogene extinction, about 66 million years ago, ended non-avian dinosaurs worldwide. An asteroid impact at Chicxulub is the leading documented cause.

Key threads lead to Dinosauria, Chicxulub crater, Hell Creek Formation and Birds.
